en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from hannan, from Fuleyh Bin Abu Bakr Al Shaybani who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The impatient false oath inherits the consequence of poverty’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Fianan from Fulayh ibn abu Bakr al-Shaybaniy who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Taking an oath which is false and binding causes poverty consequently.’”
